manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Observe how gravity continues to pull downward even when the tossed ball pauses momentarily at its highest point.
manifest.description: A vertical height scale shows a ball tossed upward. A blue arrow indicates velocity, shortening as the ball rises and pointing downward as it falls, while a dashed warm arrow represents constant downward gravitational acceleration.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
